name: Hotel Sukh Sagar
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor-listed at 0km from Shri Ballaleshwar Ashtavinayaka temple — the closest pure-veg Maharashtrian thali stop to the Astavinayak Pali shrine. Listed on Restaurant Guru + Wanderlog too. Pilgrim-trade kitchen with reliable thali at fixed prices.
insider_tip: Modak fresh-steamed daily; ask if you want a take-away box. Pithla bhakri (gram-flour curry + jowar flatbread) is the village-Maharashtrian signature. Open 7am-10pm.
signature_address: Pali village, opposite Ballaleshwar Ashtavinayak temple, Sudhagad taluka, Raigad 410205

name: Keshar Vegetarian Treat
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor-listed pure-veg sit-down 1.3km from Ballaleshwar temple — broader menu (paneer + tandoor) than Sukh Sagar, useful for groups with kids and non-pilgrim travellers using Pali as a base for Sudhagad Fort (20km). The reliable backup when Sukh Sagar lunch queue is heavy.
insider_tip: Veg thali (₹250) at lunch is the order; paneer butter masala is the kid-safe choice for fussy eaters. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Pali, 1.3km from Ballaleshwar temple, Sudhagad taluka, Raigad 410205

name: Pandits Hotel Landmark
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor-noted for 'delicious misal pav, vada pav, thalipeeth, sabudana khichdi' — the Khopoli-Pen highway snack-anchor for road-trippers between Mumbai/Khopoli and Pali. Maharashtrian snacks specialist, useful as a breakfast stop before Pali darshan.
insider_tip: Misal pav (₹80) + cutting chai (₹15) is the rare combo with both medium-spicy and 'extra-spicy' missal options. Open 7am-10pm. Cash + UPI; ample parking.
